mapping.draft_py:
# River's Rebuke: "Return all nonland permanents target player controls to their owner's hand."
# M21 Teferi, Timeless Voyager's [-8] "Each creature target opponent controls" (ALL over the
# battlefield with CONTROLLER_IS TARGET_OPPONENT, which opens the player target) with "target
# player" (TARGET_PLAYER) and "nonland permanent" (FAnd(IS_PERMANENT, FNot(TYPE_EQ Land)), ZNR
# Into the Roil), moved to their owner's hand (Zone(HAND, OWNER), Unsummon's bounce).
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAnd(children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.TARGET_PLAYER),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT),
                    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land')),
                )),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
        }),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: Return all nonland permanents target player controls to their owner's hand.

mapping.notes: Teferi, Timeless Voyager's -8 shape (ALL with CONTROLLER_IS TARGET_PLAYER opens the player target) over nonland permanents (FAnd(IS_PERMANENT, FNot(TYPE_EQ Land))), to Zone(HAND, OWNER). G1 offers both players; lands stay.

clauses.evidence: Trace: target slot 1..1 of [you, opp]; [cast targets=['you']] moves you_bear, you_giant, you_relic, you_charm to hand (hand 7 -> 10, none of the opponent's); [cast targets=['opp']] moves opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant, opp_relic, opp_charm to hand (hand 2 -> 8, none of yours): every nonland permanent of the chosen player and only theirs, mana C-4 U-2. The standard board has no land on the battlefield and no permanent changes control, so 'nonland' and 'their owner's' are not shown. Pack B06_1 PASSES: the opponent's Island stays and so do the caster's own permanents; the opponent's creature and artifact go to its hand, its token ceases to exist, and a creature seat 0 OWNS but seat 1 controls goes to seat 0's hand (the owner's). Wrong twins fail.
